name: g1_locomotion_smoke
_note: Milestone A. Pretrained NVIDIA Decoupled WBC walk/balance policies (weights in experiments/configs/wbc_policy.json) on the free-standing G1 in MuJoCo. Seeds set the start yaw, small initial joint offsets, odometry noise and goal positions. Gates written before the first run; seeds 100-109 were never used in development (the feasibility check used one start state and the 0.4 m/s and 0.5 rad/s commands).
